evidenceIndex.claim: Package execution is pinned, causal, fail-closed and root-cause oriented.
evidenceIndex.result: All field work must be exact-ref and evidence-bound; package text cannot override runtime truth.

evidenceIndex.claim: Canonical package rebaseline after legacy Field package deletion.
evidenceIndex.result: All historical unit results are invalidated for closure.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Executor must re-fetch A before every write/push and final closure.

evidenceIndex.claim: Field/Captain are independent providers and Field has no shifts, while current contracts/UI still contain drift.
evidenceIndex.result: Workforce/Identity creation and contract cleanup are in scope.

evidenceIndex.claim: Current Field create UI is wired to a deprecated dead controller while live and provisioning-case APIs coexist.
evidenceIndex.result: One canonical field creation command and deletion of obsolete paths are required.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Exact caller graph must be rechecked before deletion.

evidenceIndex.result: Activation readiness must be unified and consumed consistently.

evidenceIndex.claim: Field provider detail has duplicate views and partially unwired media/save/operational UI.
evidenceIndex.result: Canonical profile UI and cleanup are required.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Routing must be traced before deleting one view.

evidenceIndex.claim: Assignment lifecycle and self-start onboarding both exist/are required but need one canonical downstream lifecycle.
evidenceIndex.result: Partners field workspace, provenance, SLA and collaboration are in scope.
evidenceIndex.limitations: No unrelated Partners feature is implied.

evidenceIndex.claim: Visits/checklists/evidence exist but checklist policy is effectively static and location proof is not the final approved model.
evidenceIndex.result: Vertical-managed checklist and event-based location evidence are in scope.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Server policy/storage must be traced before changes.

evidenceIndex.claim: Field catalog is central-master based with store-local data and proposals.
evidenceIndex.result: Catalog truth is preserved while proposal/publication ownership is corrected.

evidenceIndex.source: user-approved product decision 2026-08-14 + Control Panel marketing section
evidenceIndex.claim: Store publication is a Marketing responsibility with automatic gate and audited override.
evidenceIndex.result: Marketing is causally in scope for field-originated publication.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Does not pull generic campaigns/coupons/loyalty into scope.

evidenceIndex.result: Extend only required offline coverage and preserve unknown-result safety/quarantine.

evidenceIndex.claim: WLT owns field finance, but Field UI currently includes incidents and shared provider-incident backend exists.
evidenceIndex.result: Keep wallet/commission/payout; remove field incidents/penalties and COD from Field scope.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Shared non-field consumers must be proven before deleting shared code.

evidenceIndex.claim: Field has test/type/lint/build gates but not full cross-surface/device closure evidence.
evidenceIndex.result: Final exact-SHA E2E evidence remains required.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static test inventory is not a PASS result.

evidenceIndex.claim: Control Panel sections are enumerable and only field-causal sections belong in execution.
evidenceIndex.result: All sections are assessed, with causal ones mapped to units and others excluded with reopen triggers.
evidenceIndex.limitations: A newly created section requires coverage refresh.

evidenceIndex.claim: Superseded app-field-final-closure and app-field-multisurface-journeys packages were removed.
evidenceIndex.result: field-3 is the only active field package.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Git history remains historical provenance by design.
